summary: Use your own OpenAI or Gemini key on your agent.

improvements: Your agent can run on your own OpenAI key, or your own Gemini key, exactly as you chose it in Bring your own AI.
Your agent tells the app which AI providers it supports, so the app can offer this update when it is needed.
fixes: A key your provider refuses is reported plainly instead of quietly switching to another model.
security: Your key reaches your agent sealed to its own key and stays in its encrypted log; Hussh never sees it.
Only your own session can set, read or clear your AI choice.
